messages:
alex: Heads-up — enterprise POC with DataSuite signed today. They want a 3-week POC with reserved capacity and AZ affinity. Need throughput sizing + prewarm plan.
maria: Congrats! Any traffic profile yet? qps/seq len?
alex: Initial profile: peak 450 qps, avg 120 qps, 95th perc seq len ~512 tokens. Burst windows 10–20% for 30s. Goal is <120ms p95 gen latency for chat flows.
devin: ok for baseline. With 8-bit quant and batching we estimate ~70 qps per A100-equivalent GPU at p95 for 512. So peak 450 -> ~7 GPUs reserved + headroom.
sarah: we should recommend 2x safety margin for commit contracts. Suggest reserving 14 GPUs for dedicated commit and configure burst credits for spikes.
liam: 14 seems big, sales will push back. Could we do 10 reserved + autoscale to 14 with prewarm? How many concurrent prewarmed workers do we need?
devin: Autoscale cold starts are ~12s for a new worker, prewarm reduces that to <1s if KV cache warmed. For 4 additional GPUs prewarmed across AZs we'd need warm replicas per AZ. Suggest policy: min_replicas=10, prewarm_replicas=4, max_replicas=14.
maria: they want AZ affinity to keep latency stable and for compliance. Can we lock reserved GPUs to AZs and have cross-AZ fallback?
sre-bot: Note: cross-AZ fallback increases egress risk and may violate their compliance requirement unless transit is approved.
sarah: For fallback, add explicit fallback policy: route to same-AZ reserved pool; if saturated for >15s, spill to other AZ guarded by encryption at rest/in transit and logged. Add approval checkbox in contract.
alex: Pricing question: sales asks for a blended committed rate for reserved GPUs + per-use for bursts. Any guidance?
devin: Typical structure: base monthly for reserved (14 GPUs * price_unit) discounted 30% for commit, burst billed at on-demand rate, but cap monthly overage at 20% of commit cost with auto-notify.
liam: Can we propose an alternate lower-commit option: 10 GPUs committed at 40% discount, with guaranteed 4 prewarm burst credits included per month?
maria: that might work for middle-market. For enterprise, they want predictability — prefer firm commit + autoscale headroom for emergencies.
alex: Security Q: they asked about KMS/HSM for model keys and audit logs retention 13 months. Is that covered in Private?
sre-bot: Private + KMS integrations supported. Audit retention configurable up to 24 months for enterprise plans.
sarah: Action items I can take: 1) write POC capacity playbook with sizing table (qps->GPU counts) 2) draft autoscale policy YAML 3) draft pricing options 10 vs 14 commit scenarios 4) contract fallback clause.
devin: I'll prepare the capacity table and a short perf runbook for the POC load generator (qps/seq len profiles).
maria: I'll sync with legal on fallback wording and with cloud infra on AZ pinning feasibility.
liam: Sales will need a simple 1-pager comparing costs and risks for 10 vs 14 commit. I can do that after devin and sarah items land.
alex: timeline: want POC runbook and pricing options by EOD Thursday for customer review Friday.
sarah: noted. I'll drop the autoscale YAML here when ready. Example snippet I'll use:
```yaml
autoscale_policy:
  min_replicas: 10
  prewarm_replicas: 4
  max_replicas: 14
  scale_up_threshold_p95_qps: 0.75
  scale_down_threshold_p95_qps: 0.35
  cooldown_secs: 30
  az_affinity: true
  fallback_policy:
    enable_cross_az_spill: true
    max_spill_duration_secs: 15
```
liam: perfect. Also add a metric to emit when spill occurs so sales/legal can audit.
devin: will add a sample guard metric: `inference.spill.cross_az.count` with tags {az_from, az_to, model}.
maria: any blockers on infra side?
sre-bot: Request ticket created: INF-8219 to validate AZ pinning + KMS across zones. ETA 48h.
alex: great — next sync Wednesday 11am. Thanks team :thumbsup:
